Example crops of five TCGA slides

Source: R/example-data.R
tcga_crops.Rd

One square region per slide, with all the cells detected inside it. Each region was chosen inside the tissue mask, where neoplastic and stromal cells are most balanced, and holds about 12,000-30,000 cells.

Usage

tcga_crops

Format

A named list of 5 marked point patterns (ppp), named by TCGA patient barcode. Coordinates are in pixels of the 40x slide; the marks are a factor with the cell types benign epithelial, inflammatory, necrotic, neoplastic, no label and stromal. The window of each pattern is the square intersected with the tissue mask.

Source

H&E diagnostic slides from The Cancer Genome Atlas (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov), cells segmented and classified with HoVer-Net. Built by data-raw/tcga_examples.R.
